timer.start: the work-started event emitted when the neutral prompt and fresh starting scaffold become visible to the new agent session
timer.firstLocalLiveRowStop: the first milestone-observed:first-local-live-row event whose evidence digest proves a provider-native authoritative row is visible through the required React web surface
timer.hostedLiveUrlStop: the first milestone-observed:hosted-live-url event whose evidence digest proves the public origin serves the actual React application and reads one authoritative row from the hosted backend
timer.clock: one monotonic nanosecond clock per sample; wall clock is retained for audit and never computes elapsed margins

commands.topLevel: one command-started event with authored=true for each command deliberately issued by the agent; commands spawned by that command are not counted separately
commands.wrapper: a shell script, package script, task runner, or compound shell line authored during the timed sample counts as one command but must name its wrapper; a wrapper supplied byte-for-byte by the pinned starting scaffold counts as the invoked top-level command only
commands.localAggregation: count authored command-started events at or before first-local-live-row
commands.hostedAggregation: count authored command-started events at or before hosted-live-url

agentUsage.tokens: sum inputTokens and outputTokens from agent-usage events; cachedInputTokens is reported separately and is already included in inputTokens
agentUsage.sessionBoundary: one fresh agent session per warmup or timed sample; no conversational state crosses samples or arms

sampleOrder.executionSequence: one safe-integer sequence is contiguous across retained timed observations; the first retained value may follow separately retained warmups
sampleOrder.alternation: timed slots are Convex 1, Snapback 1, through Convex 7, Snapback 7
sampleOrder.invalidReplacement: an instrument-invalid observation is retained and the immediately following observation repeats the same arm and ordinal; the slot advances only after a valid observation
sampleOrder.closure: the scoring input contains every retained timed observation from exactly one capsule and run, and its selected per-arm valid arrays exact-match the one valid observation closing each slot

classifications.expected-refusal: a required negative witness named by expectedByGateId; does not count as a failure
classifications.unexpected-failure: a required operation failed outside an expected negative witness
classifications.retry: the agent or harness repeats an operation because the prior outcome did not establish the required result
classifications.required-skip: a required gate could not execute; never a pass
classifications.human-intervention: a human changes state or gives sample-specific guidance after work-started
classifications.unplanned-credential-repair: credentials require repair not included in the pinned precondition ceremony
classifications.correctness-failure: the application violates a required product fact
classifications.security-failure: cross-user access, secret exposure, authority bypass, target confusion, or another protocol security floor fails
classifications.cleanup-defect: the sample cannot deterministically remove every resource named by its capsule
classifications.instrument-failure: measurement infrastructure, not either product arm, failed; requires a named documenter and retained rationale

perMetricAggregation.elapsed: sample median decides; nearest-rank p95 and bootstrap intervals are informational
perMetricAggregation.commands: sample median of per-sample top-level counts decides
perMetricAggregation.tokens: sample median of per-sample total agent tokens decides
perMetricAggregation.toolCalls: sample median of per-sample tool calls decides
perMetricAggregation.failureRetrySkipCounts: sample median decides comparator-relative margins; every raw count remains in the receipt
perMetricAggregation.absoluteZeroFloors: sum across every valid and invalid observation; any human intervention, unplanned credential repair, correctness failure, security failure, or cleanup defect fails its zero floor
